question: What kind of rosary is said to grant fulfillment of all purposes?
premises: Rosaries can be made from different materials.
Elephant-tusk beads are specified as material.
Such a rosary is described as granting all purposes.
inference: A rosary made of elephant-tusk beads should be made for achieving all purposes.
plain_english: One should make a rosary of elephant-tusk beads, for it grants all purposes.
